mutations.label: M604A the preview threshold is raised past any real body, so NO message is ever previewed and #604's entire saving disappears -- check_inbox is 63% of all tool-io tokens (68.9M of 108.6M over 45 runs). Every asserted substring survives: `len(body) > _INBOX_PREVIEW_LEN` is untouched.

M604B `and` becomes `or`, so a long UNREAD body is truncated -- data loss on first delivery, which is exactly what `test_an_unread_body_is_still_delivered_WHOLE` claims to guard. The asserted prefix `is_preview = bool(msg.get("_was_read"))` survives VERBATIM because the assertion is a substring check.
M604C the preview keeps NONE of the body, so a read message is replaced by its own footer. The asserted `search_messages` / `eventhub_get_thread` strings are in the footer and survive.
M604D CONTROL, expected CAUGHT: the recovery hint loses `search_messages`, which the test asserts directly -- so this one must be seen and proves the spec is wired to a live test.
